title: Settings
subtitle: Adjust preferences without leaving your workspace

gitAccountEmpty: No Git accounts yet — add one to get started
createGitAccountDescription: Name and email are required. The new account is enabled and written to git config --global.
editGitAccountDescription: Update name or email. If this account is enabled, global git config is synced.
gitAccountRequired: Git username and email are required
gitAccountDuplicate: An account with the same name and email already exists
gitAccountNeedOneEnabled: At least one Git account must remain enabled
sshHint: Select or generate an SSH key, then copy the public key to your Git host settings
apiKeyListHint: The enabled key is used for DeepSeek requests
createApiKeyDescription: Name and API Key are required. The new key will be enabled automatically.
apiKeyEmpty: No API keys yet. Add one to use 鲸灵.
apiKeyRequired: Enter a name and API Key
editApiKeyDescription: Only the display name changes. The API Key is neither shown nor modified.

aiInstructionsResumeHint: Only for Resume Helper chat and resume drafting — not Git commit/PR instructions
commitInstructionsHint: Included in commit message generation; JLGit defaults apply when unset — edit for your team

resumeHelperInstructionsHint: Included in Resume Helper system prompt; JLGit defaults apply when unset
